## House rules

-   Full names in Zoom
-   Cameras on
-   Microphones off
-   Questions
    -   raise hand (immediate response)
    -   write in chat (at the end of the presentation)
-   Missing in mandatory lecture &rarr; apology at least 24 hours in advance
-   Problem &rarr; ask, write email, or contact me via Moodle

## Learning objectives

-   Know the basic concepts of machine learning
-   Learn essentials of ![](https://www.r-project.org/Rlogo.png){width=5%} programming language
-   Understand how to process and analyse (educational) data
-   Gain knowledge of essentials of educational data mining and learning analytics

## Requirements

1. Active participation in the external lectures
2. Submission of all programming assignments
3. Essay

## Programming assignments

- code is working (30 points)
- code is using the best practices, is readable, and well commented (30 points)
- code is producing correct results (40 points)
- deadline: 2 weeks after the lecture

\center PASS: > 50% of points from all assignments 

## Essay

- write an essay on selected topic
- the topic will be available after the 5th lecture
- each topic can be chosen by limited number of students
- proper referencing
- arguments needs to be supported by literature
- use of genAI is allowed, but mistakes are yours
- 1000 - 1500 words
- deadline: 15th July 2025

## Moodle

- we will be using Moodle for seminars, tasks and communication
- there will be an interactive component for each seminar
- Informed Consent Management system
